observed: CYD A ROM read on USB Serial VID:PID 1a86:7523 confirmed ESP32-D0WD-V3 v3.1 and 4 MiB SPI flash at 3.3 V strap voltage.

Base MAC matches the exact Guilo cyd_b unit with working ILI9341_2 display and XPT2046 touch. This profile approval covers the preflash configuration. Vault portrait, color, touch, serial reset behavior and power-bank acceptance remain bench checks.
Flash DIO at 40 MHz follows the working esp32dev build configuration. Vault uses internal memory only. The 64 KiB minimum NVS and factory partition are Vault layout choices.

Display SPI2 is the historical HSPI wiring at a conservative 20 MHz write clock, below the prior 55 MHz configuration. Touch uses a separate SPI3 host on the historical bitbang wires at 500 kHz, with microSD disabled. Portrait uses TFT_eSPI ILI9341 rotation zero MADCTL MX and native 240 by 320 geometry.
Rafa’s November 13 photo of this unit’s Vault self-test showed red and blue swapped with RGB selected. BGR corrects the expected component order. Bench confirmation after the update remains pending.
